integrity: All-order statement is proved by spectral projectors and algebraic inequalities; finite exact-arithmetic replay is supplementary. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Endpoint positivity only for unweighted connected complete multipartite graph heat equations; stage positivity, general weighted graphs, and exact per-graph negative intervals are not asserted. Full publication-priority search remains open to unindexed sources.
title: Twelve vertices are the exact Radau IIA positivity barrier for complete multipartite graph heat flow
